texts.preamble: Majeed.R.M vs State Of Kerala on 20 February, 2019 Author: Anu Sivaraman Bench: Anu Sivaraman In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mrs. Justice Anu Sivaraman Wednesday,The 20Th Day Of February 2019 / 1St Phalguna, 1940 WP(C).No. 5163 of 2019 Petitioner: Majeed.R.M Aged 43 Years S/O. Ammad, Rayorath Meethal House, Kuttiady, Vadakara Taluk, Kozhikode District-673508. By Adv. Sri.C.Bhaskaran Respondents: 1 State Of Kerala Represented By Its Secretary, Thycaud P.O, Thiruvananthapuram-695014. 2 The Commissioner, Food Safety, Thycaud P.O, Thiruvananthapuram-695014. 3 The Assistant Commissioner, Food Safety, Ipd Building, Gh Road, Palayam, Kozhikode District-673001. 4 Jithin Raj, The Food Safety Officer, Kuttiady Circle, Kozhikode- 673508. Adv.Sri.B Vinod, Government Pleader Majeed.R.M vs State Of Kerala on 20 February, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142117039/ 1 This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On 20.02.2019, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: WP(C).No. 5163 of 2019 2 Judgment
texts.facts: Action has also been taken against the petitioner by cancellation of the licence and prosecution in respect of the offences as against him. It is also submitted that the petitioner has preferred Ext.P5 representation before the third respondent, seeking removal of the seized stock of coconut oil from the premises, so that the petitioner will be enabled to surrender vacant possession of the building to the land lord.
texts.arguments: 3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that pursuant to proceedings initiated against the petitioner under the Provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act and the Regulations issued thereunder, the premises where the coconut oil had been stocked by the petitioner had been sealed. It is submitted that the petitioner is forced to pay rent for the building through he is not conducting the business any more.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that pursuant to proceedings initiated against the petitioner under the Provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act and the Regulations issued thereunder, the premises where the coconut oil had been stocked by the petitioner had been sealed.
texts.respondent_arguments: It is submitted that the petitioner is forced to pay rent for the building through he is not conducting the business any more.
